subject: BrightLayer renewal: unit-econ recap & tactical plan
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLayer renewal: unit-econ recap & tactical plan

Alex — great conversation today, thanks for the transparency on usage patterns and the roadmap. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we can align before we loop Proc/Legal.

Call highlights (short):
- Current monthly tokens (avg): ~28M input + 72M output = ~100M tokens/month (peak 140M)
- Primary models: mix of gpt-like for chat + smaller embedding model for search (we talked about adding a second embedding route for semantic search)
- Biggest drivers for renewal: predictable $/1M token target, ability to add an embeddings-only route without a heavy price uplift, and a short runway for a blended discount once they hit +2x volume.

Proposed commercial guardrails we discussed:
- Target anchor price: $1,750 per 1M tokens for chat-heavy route at current fidelity (volume-dependent stage pricing applies)
- Embeddings route: target $600 per 1M tokens (embedding units measured separately) if kept on quantized 8-bit profile
- Blend approach for renewal: tiered blended buckets with a 30% blended floor once committed to 36-month step-up plan

Action items (next 48h):
1) Grace: share a simple token-econ workbook (attached) with 3 scenarios: conservative, expected, and upside.
2) Marcus: propose two formal pricing bands (monthly thresholds + blended math) for our quote.
3) Alex: confirm whether embeddings usage will be routed off a dedicated model or mixed in the chat path (this affects caching assumptions).
4) Alex: introduce procurement contact so we can get preliminary T&Cs and timeline.

Attachments: BrightLayer_Q1_call_notes.pdf (notes and screenshots), token_econ_v2.xlsx (scenarios).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@brightlayer.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLayer renewal: unit-econ recap & tactical plan

Thanks Grace — summary looks right. A couple clarifications from our side:
- The 100M/month figure is a consolidated view. We split roughly 60/40 between chat (conversational UI) and embeddings (vector search).
- We expect embeddings to grow faster as we roll out the recommender pilot in Q3; plan is to keep it on a dedicated, cheaper quantized route.
- Procurement (cc'd) will want the uplift math for blended vs committed volumes and confirmation of rounding on token counts.

Procurement note (from Procurement alias):
- Please include a 12/24/36 month commitment worksheet. We typically run legal review once commercial terms are agreed and there are no material changes to the SLA.

Next from our side: we'll validate the peak month and confirm the embeddings routing decision by EOD Wednesday.

Alex
Alex Chen
CTO, BrightLayer
alex.chen@brightlayer.ai | +1 (617) 555-4402

-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@brightlayer.ai>, BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BrightLayer renewal: unit-econ recap & tactical plan

Adding a couple tactical commercial options so we have concrete numbers to run by Alex/Procurement. I attached a short worksheet (also uploaded to the Drive link).

Option A — 12 month renewal, mild commitment
- Commitment: 150M tokens/month (baseline blended)
- Chat route: $1,900 / 1M tokens first band; $1,600 / 1M tokens past 300M/month
- Embeddings route: $650 / 1M tokens (dedicated quantized)
- Expected blended at current mix: $1,450 / 1M tokens

Option B — 36 month step-up (preferred for client unit-econ)
- Year 1 commitment: 100M tokens/month
- Year 2 ramp: 200M tokens/month
- Year 3 ramp: 350M tokens/month
- Chat route: starts $1,800 / 1M tokens with step-downs built into year bands
- Embeddings route: $575 / 1M tokens with guaranteed model-compatibility SLA
- Blended modeled outcome: $1,100 / 1M tokens by year 3 (assuming projected usage)

Notes:
- We should call out caching and prefix reuse assumptions in the SOW (we assume 15–20% effective token reduction where session reuse applies).
- If embeddings are routed to a separate optimized runtime, that preserves chat latency and gives us easier metering for a lower embeddings unit price.

I recommend we present both options and explicitly list the assumptions that materially change unit economics. Grace — want me to convert Option B into a short proposal PDF for Legal?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachment: token_econ_v2.xlsx

-----Original Message-----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: BrightLayer renewal: unit-econ recap & tactical plan

Alex / Procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Next steps I propose:
- Alex: confirm embeddings routing (dedicated vs mixed) by end of day Wednesday (04/07).
- Grace/Marcus: provide formal 12/24/36 month pricing bands and a short comparison PDF by Friday (04/09).
- Procurement: once bands are received, please flag any billing or SLA must-haves we should incorporate immediately.

If we get the go to share Option B as a preferred path, Marcus will prepare a short SOW appendix that calls out the caching, model-variant fallbacks, and token metering. I'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up for next week to walk procurement through the blended math.

Thanks all — attaching the workbook again for convenience.

Best,
Grace
